We would like to remember that part of the funding for our research comes from Dino Hazard sales. Thank you for funding our paleontological discoveries!

notes.title: PATCH V.1.4.021
notes.notes:
Hi!

Some players have reported strange bugs related to framerate issues. The engine that DHCB was built on is framerate-dependent, and the game is not intended to be played on monitors with refresh rates higher than 60 Hz. As the warning message states when the game starts, using higher refresh rates may cause bugs.

Today, I tested a different workaround for this issue, but there's no guarantee it will work. If you're playing on a 144 Hz monitor and everything is running smoothly without any errors, please let us know!

Have a great weekend.

Sincerely,
BC

Release date: DECEMBER, 2023
notes.notes:
Good afternoon, dear community!

Thank you for playing DHCB all this time, and sending us all your suggestions and bug reports.

It's been a long journey and we're coming to an end.

There are still few final adjustments to be made before Part 6 is completed, which is the end of the game's development.

The game is expected to be released on Steam likely in December this year.

I don't intend to release any updates until we've completed Part VI, to avoid spoilers for the grand finales before their time. 

Please bear with me. I know a few small bugs remain in the current version, but please be aware that I have already fixed them in the final version. I just won't be able to release updates before the conclusion because of what I said above.

We really like the end result. We hope you like it too.

I hope to be back with good news in a month or two.

Sincerely,
Bone Collectors.

notes.title: HUGE UPDATE: OVER 150 NEW ANIMALS
notes.notes:
Good afternoon dear players!

I'm sorry for the delay. A lot happened this month. health issues, surgery, research symposium, and much more. But here I come with the biggest update this game ever had!!!

I've been working hard with artists Felipe, Saulo, and Will to finish every animal that was still missing in the game. Ilha Grande will now look more alive than ever since now we finally have insects, lizards, frogs, turtles, and many new different organisms now wandering around the landscapes.

This is what I've working on:

Tutorials:

There are now 3 short tutorials to introduce the depth of gameplay in battles;


Map improvements:

Several new wildlife NPCs;
There are now signs showing which SAFARI ZONE the play is located in. Hopefully, this will help players find their missing animals in DinoDEX;


System improvements:

Battle interface now has icons to help players in action;
Victory scene now shows how many LOVE and HATE points the player obtained during battles;
Improvements in Russian language (thanks, Diana!);
Many bugfixes;

BIG UPDATE: Part 4 + Part 5 + Open World beta
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I sincerely hope you are all doing as great as possible during this period.

There are several excellent news!

I finally bring you PART 4, PART 5, and the open-world beta experience. It took me several months of work but I am really proud of it now. I hope you also appreciate it.

The game system has also substantially improved. You will notice it. 

However, there is a negative consequence: every save file prior to this update is now obsolete. You will need to restart a new game in order to check this new version of Dino Hazard.

I am really sorry if you lost precious data. I tried to look for a way around it and created a hidden cheat for players that want to jump straight to the new levels. I strongly recommend playing a full new game but if you want to use this cheat follow the instructions bellow:

Start a fresh new game and go to SECTOR B10. Look for that tree fern by the shore up north. Just interact with it. This will allow you to jump to the following chapter of your choice.

https://i.postimg.cc/6yfb6GTT/Game-Nrb-KRCYVXs.png

In these past months we also released the Dino Hazard Comic book! Yes! It was published by Dinoleta in partnership with BoneCollectors. The trailer is awesome! You can check it in Portuguese with English subtitles bellow:

notes.title: Update: bug fixes, new localization, comics, and collectible figures
notes.notes:
Good afternoon everyone!

I hope you had a nice turn of the year and that you are doing alright during the pandemic.

Today I bring you a small update with some minor text fixes in English. Many thanks to Diana Kurilovich for pointing those out. I also fixed the diagonal moment speed. What do you think now? Feel free to give me feedback down below.

I am also sorry for the late delay since last December. It is for a good reason. I am implementing the Spanish localization script into the game. I was also working with two scientific papers during this period. Those manuscripts are about to be submitted and then I will come back to Dino Hazard full time.

Our pixel artists Will and Daniel had also provided dozens of new NPCs for the upcoming parts 4 and 5. 

I won't deny it. I am really anxious to present to you what is about to come next.

Thank you for your patience.

Regarding the Comics project, Marcio Castro is coloring Part 1 and soon he will start posting some neat prints! 

Regarding our collectible figures, Hugo Cafasso told me the Irritators had already shipped from China! We will bring great news real soon!

notes.title: Update: New battle mechanics and design, autosave bug fix, and new equipment
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thank you all for playing our game! 

We have improved the HP-ST design in battles and menus! The interface looks beautiful now! We brought several improvements to the battle system this time.

The major bugs we have solved this time was:


The Save bug: the save wind longer freezes for some users.
The Battle animation bug: we solved all bugs related to battle animations. They look great now!


We have new battle mechanics:


Adaptive turns: Party order will change in real-time according to players' changes.
Turn order display: Now you can preview the player order prior to planning your strategies.
Break Shield: Opponents now present a shield system. If you break the shields they reach the Vulnerable state.
Weakness Display: Every opponent now has several icons revealing their weaknesses. If you hit an enemy with one of their weaknesses, you will deal extra damage.


We are also pleased to announce a new skill for battles:


Reveal I - skill: This is a new Ranger skill. It reveals the enemy's weakness. One by one.


We are also pleased to announce new equipment:


Binoculars - equip: This is a new accessory. It reveals the enemy's weakness. One by one.

notes.title: New localization: Portuguese-BR, battle speed, and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

A lot of players from the Brazilian community asked us to anticipate the Portuguese localization of the game. I have been working on a multilanguage system for this game for the past weeks. This will allow both several localizations and continuous game updates. We are happy to announce we now have a Portuguese-BR localization starting from version 0.8.1.14!

The next language localization is Russian!

We also solved several minor bug fixes during this week. Some players also wrote to us asking for faster battles. We had reprogrammed the opponents, the skills, and the battles too. The game is flowing must faster now.

I will concentrate on polishing the battle system for the next weeks.

May you all have a great gaming weekend!

Jurassic hug,
BoneCollectors.

The major bug we have solved this time was:


The Sahitisuchus bug;


We have one new big feature in the game:


Autosave slot: If you forgot saving your game in some maintenance shed, don't worry. We placed several autosave points during the narrative.


We are also pleased to announce a new skill for battles:


Distraction: Waive your arms and call the attention of the animals all over. By doing so, you may spare weakened allies while they recover.
